mapper.sql: SELECT sys09_code AS cd , sys09_name AS nm FROM sys08_code_kind INNER JOIN sys09_code ON sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id WHERE sys08_kind_cd = '${kind}' AND sys09_company_id = 0 AND sys09_apply_date <= f_today() AND ( ( COALESCE(sys09_close_yn,'false') = 'true' AND sys09_close_date >= f_today() ) OR ( COALESCE(sys09_close_yn,'false') != 'true' ) )
systemCode AS ( ) , srType AS ( ) , aprStatusCode AS ( ) , srStatus AS ( ) , devImportanceCode AS ( )

scm01_sr_id AS sr_id, scm01_system_cd AS system_cd, scm01_sr_date AS sr_date, scm01_person_id AS person_id, scm01_corp_id AS corp_id, scm01_requestor AS requestor, scm01_sr_type AS sr_type, scm01_sr_content AS sr_content, scm01_appr_status_cd AS appr_status_cd, scm01_sr_status_cd AS sr_status_cd, scm01_start_date AS start_date, scm01_due_date AS due_date, scm01_close_date AS close_date, scm01_result_content AS result_content, scm01_dev_importance_cd AS dev_importance_cd, scm01_expect_period AS expect_period, scm01_dev_content AS dev_content, scm01_dev_target AS dev_target, scm01_dev_target_etc AS dev_target_etc, scm01_sr_no AS sr_no, regexp_replace(regexp_replace(scm01_sr_content, '<[^>]*>', '', 'g'), E'&#[0-9]+;|&\\w+;', '', 'g') AS sr_arrange_content, ${personNm} AS person_nm, ${corpNm} AS corp_nm, systemCode.nm AS system_nm, srType.nm AS sr_type_nm, aprStatusCode.nm AS appr_status_nm, srStatus.nm AS sr_status_nm, devImportanceCode.nm AS dev_importance_nm, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = scm01_sr_id ) AS file_count, scm01_requestor||CASE WHEN scm01_corp_id IS NULL THEN '' ELSE '('||${corpNm}||')' END AS requestor_corp_nm, COALESCE(dev_end_cnt,0)||' / '||COALESCE(dev_total_cnt,0) AS dev_count_str
mapper.select: WITH SELECT FROM scm01_sr LEFT JOIN systemCode ON systemCode.cd = scm01_system_cd LEFT JOIN srType ON srType.cd = scm01_sr_type LEFT JOIN aprStatusCode ON aprStatusCode.cd = scm01_appr_status_cd LEFT JOIN srStatus ON srStatus.cd = scm01_sr_status_cd LEFT JOIN devImportanceCode ON devImportanceCode.cd = scm01_dev_importance_cd LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) dev_total_cnt , SUM(CASE WHEN f_get_dev_status(scm10_dev_id) = '완료' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) dev_end_cnt FROM scm10_dev WHERE scm01_sr_id = scm10_sr_id ) t ON TRUE WHERE scm01_sr_id = #{srId}
SELECT to_char(scm01_sr_date, 'yymmdd-')||lpad((max(coalesce(cast(substr(scm01_sr_no,8,3) as numeric),0)) + 1)||'',3,'0') AS sr_no FROM scm01_sr WHERE scm01_sr_date = #{srDate} GROUP BY scm01_sr_date
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scm01_sr (scm01_sr_id, scm01_system_cd, scm01_sr_date, scm01_person_id, scm01_corp_id, scm01_requestor, scm01_sr_type, scm01_sr_content, scm01_appr_status_cd, scm01_sr_no) VALUES (#{req.srId}, #{req.systemCd}, #{req.srDate}, #{personId}, #{req.corpId}, #{req.requestor}, #{req.srType}, #{req.srContent}, #{req.apprStatusCd}, #{srNo})
mapper.update: UPDATE scm01_sr SET scm01_system_cd = #{req.systemCd}, scm01_sr_date = #{req.srDate}, scm01_corp_id = #{req.corpId}, scm01_requestor = #{req.requestor}, scm01_sr_type = #{req.srType}, scm01_sr_content = #{req.srContent}, scm01_appr_status_cd = #{req.apprStatusCd}, scm01_sr_no = #{srNo} WHERE scm01_sr_id = #{req.srId}
mapper.select:
WITH SELECT FROM scm01_sr INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = scm01_person_id LEFT OUTER JOIN sys15_corp ON sys15_corp_id = scm01_corp_id LEFT OUTER JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) dev_total_cnt , SUM(CASE WHEN f_get_dev_status(scm10_dev_id) = '완료' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) dev_end_cnt FROM scm10_dev WHERE scm10_sr_id = scm01_sr_id ) t ON TRUE LEFT JOIN systemCode ON systemCode.cd = scm01_system_cd LEFT JOIN srType ON srType.cd = scm01_sr_type LEFT JOIN aprStatusCode ON aprStatusCode.cd = scm01_appr_status_cd LEFT JOIN srStatus ON srStatus.cd = scm01_sr_status_cd LEFT JOIN devImportanceCode ON devImportanceCode.cd = scm01_dev_importance_cd WHERE scm01_sr_date BETWEEN CAST(#{startDate} AS date) AND CAST(#{closeDate} AS date) AND scm01_appr_status_cd = '30' AND COALESCE(scm01_system_cd, '%') LIKE #{systemCode} AND COALESCE(scm01_sr_status_cd, '10') LIKE #{srStatus}
AND ( CONCAT( emp01_kor_nm , sys15_corp_nm , scm01_requestor , scm01_sr_content , scm01_result_content , scm01_sr_no ) ILIKE #{searchText} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scm10_dev WHERE scm10_sr_id = scm01_sr_id AND ( CONCAT(f_get_dev_status(scm10_dev_id), scm10_note) ILIKE #{searchText} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scm11_dev_step WHERE scm11_dev_id = scm10_dev_id AND CONCAT(scm11_result, scm11_note) ILIKE #{searchText} ) ) ) )
AND COALESCE(scm01_sr_status_cd,'10') NOT IN ('30','80','90')
ORDER BY scm01_sr_date DESC, scm01_sr_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE scm01_sr SET scm01_sr_status_cd = #{req.srStatusCd}, scm01_due_date = #{req.dueDate}, scm01_start_date = #{req.startDate}, scm01_close_date = #{req.closeDate}, scm01_dev_importance_cd = #{req.devImportanceCd}, scm01_expect_period = #{req.expectPeriod}, scm01_dev_content = #{req.devContent}, scm01_dev_target = #{req.devTarget}, scm01_dev_target_etc = #{req.devTargetEtc}, scm01_result_content = #{req.resultContent} WHERE scm01_sr_id = #{srId}
